title: Oracle Essbase Job
description: An asynchronous job executed on an Essbase database. Jobs support operations such as data loading, dimension building, calculations, data clearing, Excel import/export, LCM backup/restore, aggregation management, ASO buffer operations, data export, and MDX script execution.

job_ID.description: Unique job identifier assigned by the server.

appName.description: Name of the application the job was executed against.

dbName.description: Name of the database the job was executed against.

jobType.description: Type of job that was executed.

jobfileName.description: Name of the script or file associated with the job.

userName.description: User ID of the person who submitted the job.

startTime.description: Job start time in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

endTime.description: Job end time in milliseconds since Unix epoch. Null if the job is still running.

statusCode.description: Numeric status code indicating job state. 100=In Progress, 200=Completed, 300=Completed with Warnings, 400=Failed.

statusMessage.description: Human-readable status message describing the current job state.

jobInputInfo.description: Input parameters that were used to execute the job. Structure varies by job type.

jobOutputInfo.description: Output and results of the job execution. Structure varies by job type.

recordsProcessed.description: Number of records successfully processed (for data load jobs).

recordsRejected.description: Number of records rejected during processing (for data load jobs).

errorMessage.description: Error message if the job failed or had warnings.

JobInput.description: Input for executing an asynchronous job.

JobParameters.description: Job-specific parameters. Required fields depend on the job type.

file.description: Source file name for dataload, dimbuild, or mdxScript jobs.

rule.description: Rules file name for dataload or dimbuild jobs.

abortOnError.description: Stop on first error (true/false) for dataload jobs.

script.description: Calculation script name (.csc file) for calc jobs.

partialDataExpression.description: MDX expression for partial data clear.

zipFileName.description: Backup zip file name for lcmExport/lcmImport jobs.

restructureOption.description: Data preservation option for dimension build jobs.

commitOption.description: Commit option for ASO buffer commit jobs.

type.description: Media type of the linked resource.
